Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Helpful conversation — wanted to capture the main takeaways and next steps so we have a single action plan: 

1) Authentication model you prefer
   - FintechCo leaning toward service-account-based JWTs (short-lived) for server-to-server integrations; API keys for internal dev/testing only.
2) Key rotation expectations
   - You called out quarterly rotation + emergency revocation; we can support both via our service account + key rotation APIs and offer automated rotation hooks.
3) SDK / onboarding
   - Dev wants an opinionated SDK path (Node + Java) and an example for prefix-based caching + structured output/tool-calling.
4) Embeddings / reranker
   - Plan to run embeddings for semantic search; you'll want a reranker candidate to keep latency under 150ms for top-k. We suggested a cached reranker flow to reduce cost.

Next steps (proposed):
- Dev/engineering sync: 30–45m technical call to confirm service-account flow and sample rotation config (Proposed: Wed 4/14 10:00 PT) — action: Alex/Priya to confirm
- We (Redwood) will share a short "SDK setup + key rotation" repo + sample config by EOD tomorrow — action: Marissa/Dev
- Legal/procurement: we understand standard entitlements; will loop in procurement if you want to proceed with a Dedicated reserved instance — action: Priya

Marissa / Alex / Priya —

Posting the technical notes we discussed. High level answers below; attaching an SDK quickstart and a sample rotation config.

1) Token model:
   - Recommended: short-lived signed JWTs issued by FintechCo auth service; Redwood accepts JWTs signed with a rotating public key set (JWKS). TTL 5–15 mins for bearer tokens; use refresh tokens for long-lived sessions where applicable.
   - Alternative: Redwood-managed service-account keys (we mint short-lived tokens) if you prefer minimal upstream changes.

2) Key rotation and revocation:
   - Rotation: support for rotating active jwks keys; we accept key id (kid) in JWT header. Recommend rotating signing keys weekly for CI/CD service accounts, quarterly for long-lived keys.
   - Revocation: immediate revocation via our key revocation API; we can push revocation events into your SIEM or a webhook.

3) RBAC / scopes:
   - We support scope-based tokens (scopes: embeddings.read, embeddings.write, generation.read, generation.write, admin). You can create service accounts with scoped keys.

4) Audit logs / SIEM:
   - We can stream token-level logs to your Splunk endpoint (HTTPS collector) or provide daily S3 exports with signed manifests.

Attached: redwood-sdk-setup.md, key-rotation-sample-config.yaml.

Let me know if you want a short sample showing how to rotate a key via CI/CD pipeline (we have a Terraform + GitHub Actions snippet). Happy to include that on the call.

—Dev
Dev Patel
